    "None of these items meets a current need. My nails, wood screws and drywall anchors point toward fastening work, while cutting wheels and precision measuring tools serve different tasks.",
    "Relay harnesses, heat shrink tubing, wire connectors and test leads assume an electrical project that my recent purchases do not suggest.",
    "The pipe coupling requires a matching plumbing task and size; I have no current reason to choose it.",
    "Glue has some connection to household repairs, but I have no immediate adhesive task, and packs of twelve or twenty-four exceed my needs."

  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Shopping for construction fasteners seems to have been taken as interest in almost any workshop supply, although I choose supplies for specific jobs.",
    "My household maintenance purchases seem to have been stretched into assumed plumbing, electrical and temperature-measuring needs."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The repeated purchases of framing nails, wood screws and drywall anchors are a stronger clue to my current work than a broad interest in tools.",
    "Specifications matter: nail angle and collation, screw dimensions and anchor fit determine whether a fastening supply is useful to me.",
    "My vacuum bag purchase points to a replacement compatible with a particular appliance, rather than a general need for unrelated repair supplies.",
    "I need a clear task and a suitable quantity before choosing an item; being potentially useful someday is not enough."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognized a broad maintenance theme but missed the specific fastening tasks and replacement needs that explain my recent choices."
